eSignLaw.citation: Regulation (EU) 910/2014 art. 25; Latvian Electronic Documents Law

levelNote: An electronic signature cannot be denied legal effect only because it is electronic (eIDAS art. 25(1)).

formRequirements.note: Wills need a handwritten signature or a notary.
Property transactions need a notarial deed for registration.

notices: Electronic signature law that applies: eIDAS Regulation and the Latvian Electronic Documents Law. An electronic signature cannot be denied legal effect only because it is electronic (eIDAS art. 25(1)).
You must be at least 18 years old to sign this agreement.
A Latvian translation of this agreement may be available on request.
If you are unsure whether this applies to you, ask for a paper alternative before signing.
limitationNote: Verify against the Latvian Civil Law before relying on this period.
